name: fivepaths
description: FivePaths house tooling for Claude Code. Writes documents in the cdn.fivepaths.com design system and publishes them to share.fivepaths.com with per-recipient access through the Share API and MCP server, emailing recipients only when asked, without opening the Share website. Fetches a client project’s context repository for the site repository a session is working in, resolved through the support hub.
